Consequence realized in this bundle: tests/fixtures/capability-resolver/resolve-project-context-match/warn-cardinality-nested-node/{project-context.yaml,capability-registry.json} appear in NO Outputs table row (0 matches) and are absent from the bundle, while every sibling warn-cardinality fixture is present -- so the sole evidence closing this pass's own Major 2 (a composite `any` predicate with two WARN-producing leaf children in ONE evidence tree) cannot be verified at all.

The mutation-kill arithmetic for this pass's headline Major 1 does not close: 'baseline 112/0 -> mutant 98/1'. 98 + 1 = 99, leaving 13 assertions that neither passed nor failed -- i.e. never executed. The conclusion drawn in the same sentence, 'EXACTLY the required_facets assertion, confirming (not merely asserting) that the other four fields are unaffected by this specific mutant', therefore does not follow: the capabilities / resolved_gates / lite_eligibility / capability_minimum_enforcement assertions may be among the 13 that never ran. The shortfall is neither disclosed nor explained, and it is not a whole-case abort at that point (only 8 assertions follow required_facets inside full-pipeline-match). By contrast every other mutation record in the bundle balances exactly (M3 112/0->100/12, M4 112/0->110/2, MUT-9 112/0->110/2). Compounding this: unlike M3 and M4, neither MUT-7 nor MUT-9 has a retained capture log anywhere in the bundle -- both of this pass's named Majors rest on narrative claims alone, and the one with checkable arithmetic fails that check.

cap-gamma was added specifically to de-confound AC-007's five aggregate Facet-Manifest fields, and does so for four of them (gamma-facet / gate-never / external_identity / the id itself are each unique to cap-gamma, verifiable in the bundled fixture). It does NOT declare `minimum_enforcement` at all, so `capability_minimum_enforcement` remains confounded: cap-beta alone contributes 'required' whether the field aggregates over the matched set or over the whole Registry, and the assertion labelled 'capability_minimum_enforcement (AC-007; confounded on this fixture)' cannot fail under the very defect it exists to catch. This is disclosed in the report rather than hidden, but it is still an AC-007 element with a non-discriminating assertion after six remediation waves, closable by one added key on cap-gamma. The report additionally concedes that the other four fields' exact-equality checks 'would need their own separate mutants to prove non-vacuous; none currently exist'.

Each POSIX/PowerShell log pair is byte-identical (recorded SHA-256 `b1aebc34...`, `59edb34c...`, `9a40e50e...` respectively) and the driver emits no launcher marker -- the RESULT line and every PASS label are launcher-independent.
